# Mixed notes

Frozen Phase-C fixture. Do not edit.

Today I reviewed 単語 from the last two weeks and then went back to conditional
forms. The point of this file is that one Japanese query has to reach both a
Japanese-only note and this mixed one.

毎日日本語を勉強しています — same sentence as `02-japanese-prose.md`, on purpose:
a long-query search must return two notes, a short 勉強 search must return the
same two.
